AgentLinkSection.description:
`[agent_link]`: where the out-of-process agent of this definition's calls listens
(`docs/AGENT_PROTOCOL.md`). Without it the server-wide `BRISVOX_AGENT_URL` applies.

allow_insecure.description:
Accept a plaintext `ws://` URL to a host outside the private networks (loopback,
RFC 1918, link-local, `*.internal`, ...). Default `false`: such a URL is refused at
startup, because the link carries transcripts and tool calls. Also
`BRISVOX_AGENT_ALLOW_INSECURE=1`.

caller_identity.description:
Give this definition's agent process the caller's number, the called number and the
carrier's call id in `session.start.call` (telephony calls only; `docs/AGENT_PROTOCOL.md`,
"Caller identity"). Default: `BRISVOX_AGENT_CALLER_IDENTITY`, else `false`. The numbers
are withheld while the server redacts phone numbers (`docs/PRIVACY.md`).

routes.description:
Other agent processes a call may pick by name in its start message (the websocket
start message's metadata key `agent_route`, the TwiML parameter `agent_route`).

token_env.description:
Environment variable holding the bearer token for `url`. Default: the value of
`BRISVOX_AGENT_TOKEN`.

url.description: The agent process's `ws://` or `wss://` URL; wins over `BRISVOX_AGENT_URL`.

allow_insecure.description: As `[agent_link] allow_insecure`, for this route only.

caller_identity.description:
As `[agent_link] caller_identity`, for this route only. Never inherited from the
section or the environment: a route may be another team's agent, which gets the
caller's number only when its own entry says so. Default `false`.

name.description: The name a start message uses (1-32 letters, digits, `_`, `-`).

token_env.description:
Environment variable holding this route's bearer token. A route never gets the default
token: it may be another team's agent.

confirm_tools.description:
Tools of `tools` that are held for the user's confirmation: when the model calls one, it
does not run; the model is told to ask the user, and the tool runs only after the user's
next reply confirms (`docs/TOOLS.md`, "Confirmation gate"). Each must be a SideEffect
tool and be listed in `tools`. Use it for tools whose misuse costs something: a transfer,
a payment, a booking.

language.description:
Conversation language: `en` or `tr` (optionally with a region, `tr-TR`). Selects the
segmenter's abbreviations and the speech normalizer, and is the default STT and TTS
language.

name.description: Agent name (1-64 letters, digits, `_`, `-`), used in logs and metrics.

system_prompt.description: The system prompt (non-empty, at most 100 000 bytes).

tools.description:
Tools the agent may call, by name (1-64 letters, digits, `_`, `-`; checked after reading
so a bad entry is reported at its own position). The deployment registers their
implementations; `AgentConfig::check_tools` checks
they exist.

oneOf.description: Send nothing; the model's default applies.

call_sample_rate.description:
Call rate (both directions) assumed when the transport reports none (telephony
transports report 8000 themselves). Default 16000.

frame_ms.description:
Length of one audio frame. Default 20; must be a whole number of samples at 16 kHz and
at `call_sample_rate`.

BackchannelSet.description:
The backchannel phrase sets a definition may name (`interruption.backchannels`; the reader
compares case-insensitively). Schema only.

endpointing_ms.description: Provider endpointing silence; 0 turns it off. Default 300.

description.description: When to use it, shown to the model (cut to 120 characters).

name.description: The name the model uses (1-32 letters, digits, `_`, `-`).

number.description: The E.164 number (`+` and 8 to 15 digits).

fall_delay_ms.description: Time below the VAD threshold before the hint. Default 64.

max_per_turn.description: Early analyses per user turn. Default 4.

max_tail_ms.description: Most audio since the snapshot for the verdict to be reused. Default 300.

FillerSection.description:
`[filler]`: when a slow tool round is announced with a filler phrase. The phrase
itself (and its pre-rendered clip) is set in code (`SessionBuilder::with_filler_policy`,
`with_filler_clips`); the default is "One moment, please.".

delay_ms.description:
Time without a tool result before the filler, the same for every tool that has a filler.
Default 1200.

per_tool.description:
`true`: each tool's own delay (its `filler_after`, 700 ms unless the tool sets another)
instead of `delay_ms`. Default `false`; cannot be combined with `delay_ms`.

base_url.description: Replaces the Gemini API base URL.

code_switching.description: Let Gladia switch languages inside a session.

oneOf.description: The recommended guards (300 ms speech, echo window, backchannels).
Every guard off: any barge-in interrupts at once.

backchannel_max_speech_ms.description: Speech after which a backchannel verdict stops blocking (0: no cap).

backchannel_wait_ms.description: Wait for a first interim before a candidate is assumed not to be a backchannel.

backchannels.description: Backchannel phrase sets: any of `"en"`, `"tr"`; `[]` turns them off.

echo_guard_ms.description: Echo window at the start of the bot's audio (0: off).

echo_min_words.description: Words STT must confirm inside the echo window.

min_speech_ms.description: VAD must stay active this long before a barge-in interrupts (0: off).

min_words.description: Interim words needed before a barge-in interrupts (0: off).

vad_hangover_ms.description: The VAD's minimum silence before it reports the stop.

oneOf.description: Any OpenAI Chat Completions compatible server (Groq, Together, Fireworks, vLLM, Ollama, OpenRouter).

LlmSection.description: `[llm]`: the provider, its key, the runner settings and one options table named after it.

api_key_env.description:
Environment variable holding the API key. Required except for `openai_compatible`
(a local vLLM or Ollama needs none).

context_window_tokens.description: Token budget of the context window. Default 4000.

max_tool_rounds.description: Model calls per user turn that may request tools. Default 6.

secondary.description:
`[llm.secondary]`: a second LLM provider that takes over a request the primary
failed before any content. Takes the keys above except `max_tool_rounds`,
`context_window_tokens` (the call's, from the primary's table) and `secondary`.

anyOf.description: `true`: the server's `name` and an underscore (`github_`); `false`: no prefix.
This text (1-32 letters, digits, `_` or `-`), used as it is.

McpPrefix.description:
`mcp.servers[].prefix`: whether and how the server's tool names are prefixed, to keep two
servers' tools (or a tool and one of the server's own) from clashing.

McpSection.description:
`[mcp]`: the MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers whose tools the agent may call
(`docs/TOOLS.md`, "MCP tools"). The server connects to each once at startup; a tool in a
server's `tools` allowlist is offered to the LLM like a tool of the server itself.

McpServerEntry.description:
One `[[mcp.servers]]` entry: an MCP server, reached by `command` (stdio) or `url`
(streamable HTTP), and the tools of it the agent may call.

allow_insecure.description:
url only: accept a plaintext `http://` URL to a host outside the private networks.
Default `false`: such a URL is refused at startup, because tool arguments and results
carry what the caller said, with or without a bearer token.

bearer_env.description: url only: environment variable holding a bearer token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer`.

command.description:
stdio transport: the program to start (looked up on `PATH`). Exactly one of `command`
and `url`.

confirm.description:
The tools of `tools` held for the user's confirmation (`docs/TOOLS.md`, "Confirmation
gate"). They must not be in `read_only`.

env.description:
stdio only: environment variables for the program, `NAME = "value"`. The program gets
nothing else from the server's environment but `PATH` (and, on Windows, the variables the
system needs to start a program): the server's provider keys do not reach it. A value
is not a secret store: use `env_from` for secrets.

env_from.description:
stdio only: environment variables for the program whose value comes from a variable of
the server's own environment, `CHILD_NAME = "SERVER_VARIABLE"`. The file names the
variable, never holds the value; a variable that is not set stops the start.

filler_after_ms.description: Time without a result after which the filler phrase plays (`[filler]`). Default 700.

max_in_flight.description:
Most calls to this server in flight at once, over all of the server's calls. A call over
the limit fails at once with a "busy" tool error (a side-effect tool is then not sent at
all). Default 32, at most 256.

name.description:
The server's name (1-32 letters, digits, `_`, `-`; each once): used in logs and errors,
and as the tool-name prefix with `prefix = true`.

prefix.description:
Prefix for the names the LLM sees: `true` for `<name>_`, or a text. Default none. A name
the LLM cannot use (the rules of a tool name: letters, digits, `_`, `-`; at most 64
characters) has its other characters replaced by `_` (the `.` of `files.read`).

read_only.description:
The tools of `tools` that only read (no side effects): they may run speculatively and are
dropped when the caller interrupts. Every other tool is treated as having side effects
(never speculative, never run twice for one call). The server's own `readOnlyHint`
annotation is not trusted: it is logged at debug level only.

startup_timeout_ms.description: Longest wait for the server to start and list its tools, at startup. Default 30000.

timeout_ms.description:
Longest wait for a result, per call. Default 5000, at most 30000. A tool with side effects
keeps running after it (the caller is told it is still working) up to 60 s.

tools.description:
The tools of the server to offer, by the server's own names: the allowlist. Required and
not empty (a server's other tools are not reachable: fail closed). A name the server does
not offer stops the start.

url.description:
streamable HTTP transport: the server's MCP endpoint, `https://...`, or `http://` to a
host on a private network (loopback, RFC 1918, link-local, `localhost`, `*.internal`,
`*.local`, a single-label service name), or to any host with `allow_insecure = true`.
No query, fragment or user info (the URL is shown in messages). Exactly one of `command`
and `url`.

openrouter_allow_fallbacks.description:
OpenRouter `provider.allow_fallbacks` (OpenRouter's default is `true`; OpenRouter-only like
`openrouter_order`). Sent only together with `openrouter_order`.

openrouter_order.description:
OpenRouter provider routing (OpenRouter-only: an error unless `preset = "openrouter"` or
`base_url` is on openrouter.ai): the upstream providers to try in this order, sent as
`provider.order` in the request body (slugs as on the model's page, e.g. `openai`; at
most 100). With `openrouter_allow_fallbacks = false` the request is served by one of them
or refused. Left out when unset.

preset.description: Vendor preset (base URL, suggested model and quirks).

reasoning_effort.description:
Sent as the top-level request field `reasoning_effort` (OpenRouter, vLLM, OpenAI and other
servers whose reasoning models think by default: `none` or `low` keeps the first token
fast). Left out when unset; a server that does not know the field may refuse the request.

parallel_tool_calls.description: Let the model call several tools at once.

OpenAiRealtimeSttOptions.description:
`[stt.openai_realtime_stt]`: a server speaking the OpenAI Realtime transcription protocol
(`docs/providers/openai-realtime-stt.md`).

base_url.description:
Server address, `ws[s]://host[:port]`. Default: the dialect's (OpenAI's cloud,
`ws://127.0.0.1:9000` for NIM, `ws://127.0.0.1:8000` for Speaches and vLLM).

delta_replaces.description: A delta replaces the hypothesis so far instead of extending it. Default: extend.

finalize_timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the answer to a commit (100..=10000 ms). Default 2000.

min_commit_ms.description:
The least audio a commit may hold (0..=2000 ms); less is answered empty without a
round trip. Default: the dialect's (100 ms for OpenAI and Speaches).

model.description:
The transcription model. Default: OpenAI `gpt-live-transcribe`, NIM the server's own;
required for `speaches` and `vllm`.

path_and_query.description: Replaces the dialect's path and query (`/v1/realtime?...`).

prompt.description: Transcription prompt (OpenAI, NIM), at most 4096 bytes.

sample_rate.description:
Rate of the audio sent. Default: the dialect's (24000 OpenAI and Speaches, 16000 NIM and
vLLM).

OpenAiSpeechOptions.description: `[tts.openai_speech]`: the server's `base_url`, and optionally a `preset` and overrides.

base_url.description: The API base including its version prefix, e.g. `http://localhost:8880/v1`. Required.

first_audio_timeout_ms.description:
Longest wait from sending a segment to its first audio byte (default 15000 ms; raise it
for a CPU server, or one that answers only when the whole segment is synthesized).

model.description: Model id (overrides the preset's; required for `generic`).

preset.description: Server quirks (model id, audio format, request fields). Default: `generic`.

warm_interval_ms.description: At most one warm-up per this many ms (default 60000), however many calls start.

warm_text.description:
Text of the background model warm-up request started at call start (audio discarded; at
most 200 bytes; `""` turns it off). Default: `"Hi."` for the `kokoro` preset, off for the
others. Hides the cold start of a GPU server that has idled (Kokoro: 2.8 s).

PiiKind.description: A kind of identifier the filter recognises (the `redact_kinds` of the `[recording]` table).

RecordingSection.description:
`[recording]`: what call recording keeps (docs/PRIVACY.md). Recording itself is
switched on by the environment (`BRISVOX_RECORDING_DIR`, the directory is not an agent
setting); a key set here wins over the matching environment variable. A `[recording]` table
without the directory is an error at startup, not a silently ignored privacy setting.

audio.description: Write each call's audio (two WAV files; audio cannot be redacted). Default `false`.

redact.description: Replace identifiers in the transcript before it is written. Default `true`.

redact_kinds.description:
Which kinds the redaction replaces: any of `email`, `iban`, `id`, `card`, `phone`,
`number`. Default all. Not empty while `redact` is on.

retention_days.description:
Delete recordings older than this many days (1 to 3650). Default 30 (the environment's
`BRISVOX_RECORDING_RETENTION` can say `forever`; the file cannot).

SherpaOnnxOptions.description:
`[stt.sherpa_onnx]`: a self-hosted sherpa-onnx streaming WebSocket server
(`docs/providers/sherpa-onnx.md`). The model decides the language; `stt.language` is not sent.

finalize_padding_ms.description:
Silence sent before `Done` so the decoder flushes the last word (0..=5000 ms, default
300; the Python server pads only 0.3 s itself, the C++ server 0.8 s: set 0 there).

finalize_timeout_ms.description:
How long to wait for the end of a `Done` exchange (the finalize answer) before answering
with the latest hypothesis (100..=10000 ms). Default 1500.

path.description: Path of the WebSocket endpoint. Default `/`.

sample_rate.description:
Rate of the audio sent: the model's training rate (the Python server does not resample).
Default 16000.

max_age_ms.description: Age after which an unconfirmed speculation is dropped. Default 5000.

max_buffered_events.description: Events a speculative response may buffer. Default 256.

on_partial.description: Also speculate on the best partial transcript at the VAD stop. Default `true`.

partial_stable_ms.description:
Stable-partial gate: offer the partial of a VAD stop only after the caller stayed silent
and the text did not change for this long. Default 0 (at once).

oneOf.description: OpenAI's Realtime API in transcription mode (needs `api_key_env`).
A self-hosted sherpa-onnx streaming WebSocket server.

A server speaking the OpenAI Realtime transcription protocol: OpenAI, NVIDIA Speech NIM,
Speaches, vLLM.

SttSection.description: `[stt]`: the provider, its key and language, and one options table named after it.

api_key_env.description:
Environment variable holding the API key. Required except for `sherpa_onnx` (no key) and
the local dialects of `openai_realtime_stt`.

secondary.description:
`[stt.secondary]`: a second STT provider calls fail over to when the primary
is down. Takes the keys above except `language` (the call's language is the primary's)
and `secondary`.

TelephonySection.description:
`[telephony]`: what the built-in telephony tools (`transfer_call`, `send_dtmf`, `end_call`)
may do on this agent's calls (docs/TELEPHONY.md). The tools exist only in a server
with a carrier's call control configured (`BRISVOX_CALL_CONTROL`, docs/OPERATIONS.md); an
agent lists the ones it uses in `agent.tools` like any other tool.

destinations.description:
Where `transfer_call` may send the call, by name: the model picks a name, never a
number. Without any, `transfer_call` is not offered.

dtmf.description: Offer `send_dtmf` when the carrier binding can send tones. Default `true`.

voicemail.description: What to do when an outbound call is answered by a machine.

warm.description:
Offer warm transfers (`transfer_call` with `mode = "warm"`: the receiving party hears a
summary first). Needs the callback listener (`BRISVOX_CALLBACK_ADDR`), which finishes a
transfer, and a carrier binding that can do it; otherwise the tool offers cold transfers
only. Default `false`.

oneOf.description:
A local server speaking the OpenAI `POST /v1/audio/speech` protocol (Kokoro-FastAPI,
Speaches, Chatterbox-TTS-Server, vLLM-Omni).

TtsSection.description:
`[tts]`: the provider, its key, voice, rate and language, and one options table named after
it.

api_key_env.description:
Environment variable holding the API key. Required except for `openai_speech` (a local
Kokoro or Chatterbox server needs none).

sample_rate.description: Rate the provider delivers (the engine resamples to the call). Default 24000.

secondary.description:
`[tts.secondary]`: a second TTS provider calls fail over to when the primary is
down. Takes the keys above, `voice` included (a voice id belongs to one provider), except
`sample_rate` and `language` (the call's, from the primary's table) and `secondary`.

voice.description:
Provider voice id (for Deepgram Aura the model string, e.g. `aura-2-thalia-en`; for
`openai_speech` the server's voice name, e.g. `af_heart` on Kokoro).

oneOf.description: Smart Turn decides; a fallback silence ends an undecided pause.
A fixed silence after the VAD stop ends the turn.

fallback_silence_ms.description: `adaptive` only: silence that ends a turn Smart Turn did not complete. Default 3000.

final_grace_ms.description: `adaptive` only: how long the STT signals may take. Default 800.

final_wait_ms.description: How long a turn end is held while STT finals are owed. Default 1500.

require_final.description: `adaptive` only: a complete verdict also waits for the STT final. Default `false`.

response_deadline_ms.description:
Backstop for a response that produces no audio. Default 20000; must exceed
`final_wait_ms`.

silence_ms.description: `fixed_silence` only (required there): silence that ends the turn.

VoicemailSection.description:
`[telephony.voicemail]`: answering-machine handling of calls the carrier's detector
classifies (`docs/TELEPHONY.md`, section 6). The verdict reaches the call as the stream
parameter `answered_by` or as a callback (`BRISVOX_CALLBACK_ADDR`). A machine whose greeting
ended is played `message`, then the call is hung up; a person gets the normal conversation.

detect_only.description:
`true` for a detector that never reports the end of a greeting (Twilio
`MachineDetection=Enable`, Telnyx `detect`): a machine is hung up on instead of being
spoken over. Default `false` (Twilio `DetectMessageEnd`, Telnyx `greeting_end`).

message.description:
The fixed message left on a machine, spoken as it is (1 to 1000 characters). Put nothing
in it the callee did not consent to hear on a recording.

on_unknown.description: What to do when the detector cannot tell. Default `treat_as_human`.

oneOf.description: Wait for the greeting to end (a fixed time), then leave the message.

agent.description: Who the agent is: name, language, system prompt, tools.

agent_link.description: The out-of-process agent the calls of this definition link to.

audio.description: Frame length and the call rate assumed when the transport reports none.

early_analysis.description: Speculative Smart Turn analysis when the VAD probability first falls.

filler.description: The phrase spoken while a slow tool runs.

llm.description: LLM provider and the runner settings.

mcp.description: MCP servers whose tools the agent may call (`docs/TOOLS.md`, "MCP tools").

recording.description: What call recording keeps and for how long; overrides the environment.

speculation.description: Speculative LLM generation at a candidate end of turn.

telephony.description: What the built-in telephony tools may do.

turn.description: How the end of a user turn is decided.
